exposure: vaginally-assisted natural orifices endoscopic transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) hysterectomy with salpingectomy/salpingo-oophorectomy
conventional laparoscopic access (LAP) hysterectomy with salpingectomy/salpingo-oophorectomy
cohort: The study included 86 patients undergoing hysterectomy with adnexectomy for benign disease indication, excluding those with endometriosis, previous pelvic radiotherapy, inflammatory pelvic disease history, concurrent surgery, laparotomy, robotic surgery, or traditional vaginal hysterectomy.
finding: The study found that vaginally-assisted natural orifices endoscopic transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) hysterectomy was comparable to conventional laparoscopic hysterectomy in terms of operative times, complications, and hospital stay.
